stageFix44.rule: sensecheck 44 (2): pasta+ragout = dish; filled pasta named after its cream sauce = dish; Käsespätzle = dish; Paprikahendl with starch side (>= 8 g carbs/100 g) = dish, else protein component; ready Faschierte Laibchen/Frikadellen = protein component (dish when the name brings the side)

classFix42.rule: sensecheck 42 (3): gyoza/dumplings are a dish (stage meal, not Zutat/Rohware); spring rolls are a snack/starter (nonMeal snack, gang vorspeise, stage side since sensecheck 44 (3), never ranked); a plain ratatouille < 300 g is a vegetable side (stage veg); Tomaten-Mozzarellanudeln = Tomaten-Mozzarella-Nudeln (meal)

pastaCheck39.rule: sensecheck 39 (3): borderline filled pasta decided on the ingredient list – sauce component in the pack = ready meal (row.sauceInPack, note 'Sauce im Pack'), only a filling = ingredient/side (nonMeal pasta)
